pageSummary: A mobile shopping demo page displaying a product card for Wireless Headphones with title, description, price, and a checkout button.

issues.description: The checkout button overflows out of the product container card to the right on mobile screens.
issues.evidence: The blue 'Proceed to Checkout' button extends beyond the boundary of the white product card and viewport content.
issues.likelyCause: Inside the @media (max-width: 600px) media query, .checkout is assigned a fixed width of 650px (width: 650px;), which exceeds the viewport and parent container width.

recommendations: Set the checkout button width to 100% instead of a fixed pixel value on mobile screens.
Use max-width: 100% on interactive elements to prevent horizontal overflow across responsive viewports.
